title: The tree at Pullman's glasshouse gate gets its young, broad head
items: The parkway tree beside the 18th Street gate to Pullman's glasshouses now stands on one straight stem with a broad, low, leafy head from about 3 m, as the 1894 Inland plate and Lowe's c. 1897 photograph show it, in place of the grown elm's forked fountain.
Its trunk is drawn about 0.27 m across, as thin as the pictures draw it.
